blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —A Ramon Magsaysay Awardee has voiced solidarity with Chin survivors seeking justice before local courts in the Philippines against what was described as “continuing Myanmar military atrocities.” Bo Kyi, a human rights defender and former political prisoner in Myanmar, called on Philippine officials on Sunday, Nov. 15, to uphold the rule of law and prosecute the junta for war crimes. “I stand in solidarity with the Chin Human Rights Organization (CHRO) and Chin survivors,” he said as he accepted the award, which is widely considered as Asia’s response to the Nobel Peace Prize. “Their unflinching courage reminds us that […]...
